summary: The Confession of Faith in a Mennonite Perspective places its hope in the reign of God and its fulfillment on the day when Christ will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead. It confesses God's final victory, the end of this present age of struggle between good and evil, the resurrection of the dead, and a new heaven and new earth where the people of God will reign with Christ in justice, righteousness and peace. Its commentary says the righteous will rise to eternal life with God and the unrighteous to hell and separation from God. The article does not describe purification after death or a thousand-year reign.

points.question: What happens when Christ returns?
points.answer: Christ will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead and gather his church; the dead will be raised, and there will be a new heaven and a new earth where God's people reign with Christ.

points.question: What is the final state of the wicked?
points.answer: The commentary says the righteous will rise to eternal life with God, and the unrighteous to hell and separation from God.
